$comment: Committed baseline for FF9 after reviewing four command-budget increases introduced by approved framework work since v5.13.4. `pause.md` grew from 4,639 to 5,416 bytes (+777) to persist active journey state and evidence before handoff. `protocol.md` grew from 36,624 to 40,777 bytes (+4,153) to enforce real extension resolution and prepare, bind, and verify journey dispatch authority, including fail-closed recovery guidance. `setup.md` grew from 6,658 to 7,521 bytes (+863) for extension-resolution setup and immutable framework snapshot installation. `update-copilot.md` grew from 3,498 to 4,733 bytes (+1,235) for the immutable snapshot update and roundtrip contract. These are reviewed security/runtime contracts, not accidental prose expansion. Policy thresholds and every unrelated measurement are carried forward unchanged from v5.13.4 so this re-baseline does not silently reset headroom for other artifacts.
byte_to_token_basis: ~4 characters per token for English/markdown text -- OpenAI's widely-published tokenizer heuristic (platform.openai.com/tokenizer: 'a helpful rule of thumb is that one token generally corresponds to ~4 characters of text'). No tokenizer dependency is added; this is a documented approximation, applied identically to every artifact so ratios between artifacts stay comparable even though the absolute token count is approximate.

thresholds.growth_ratio_basis: Matches IMPL-plan item 5's starting point: tight enough to catch a real content-bloat edit, loose enough for normal edits (a new table row, a paragraph) not to trip it. Applies uniformly to every tracked artifact (agents, commands, CLAUDE.md, the SessionStart injection file, and the frontmatter-description catalog). Unchanged from v5.13.4 -- this re-baseline resets only four reviewed command byte counts, not the policy.
thresholds.shrink_floor_basis: A single edit legitimately removing under 30% of a file (trimming a stale section) is normal; losing more than 30% in one change is the signature of an accidental body-strip or truncated write, which a growth-only budget cannot see. Unchanged from v5.13.4.
thresholds.corpus_ceiling_basis: Same 10% headroom as the per-file ratio, applied to the SUM of all 16 agent files, so many small under-ratio additions across different files (each individually compliant) still can't add up to unbounded corpus growth. Unchanged from v5.13.4.
thresholds.always_loaded_growth_ratio_basis: Deliberately tighter than every other ratio in this file (8% vs 10%) because this is the one number that taxes literally every session with zero user action -- CLAUDE.md and the SessionStart injection are read whether or not the session ever touches an agent or a command. Unchanged from v5.13.4.

agent_corpus_note: Carried forward from v5.13.4. This re-baseline reviews only four command artifacts and deliberately does not reset the agent-corpus ceiling against unrelated later growth.

always_loaded.claude_md_note: Carried forward unchanged from v5.13.4; none of the four reviewed command artifacts is auto-loaded into every session.
always_loaded.session_start_injection_note: Carried forward unchanged from v5.13.4; the runtime-computed Known References and Session Quota additions remain excluded because they are not committed static content.
always_loaded.frontmatter_catalog_note: Carried forward unchanged from v5.13.4; the reviewed changes do not alter agent frontmatter.

protocol.md.reason: Loads only on explicit `/protocol` invocation, not via an auto-loaded file or unconditional hook. It remains tracked under the ordinary per-artifact growth and shrink invariants. Since v5.13.4 it added reviewed extension-resolution enforcement and journey dispatch preparation, evidence binding, fail-closed verification, and recovery contracts, growing by 4,153 bytes.
protocol.md.verification: No PreToolUse/SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit hook reads or emits protocol.md's content; it is resolved only for an explicit /protocol command invocation.

AGENTS.md.reason: Codex-layer file, not loaded into a Claude Code session and not referenced by Claude Code hooks. Carried forward unchanged from v5.13.4.
